subject: Executive briefing lane request — Novatech demo
messages:
From: Cara Morris <cara.morris@novatech.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Executive briefing lane request — Novatech demo

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the earlier product notes — we reviewed with the platform team and would like to schedule an executive-facing demo for Novatech leadership (CTO + VP of Product) to see Redwood's latency and routing controls in action. Ideally a 45-minute session with 15 minutes reserved for Q&A.

Proposed windows: week of Nov 22 — mornings PST preferred. Also, could you confirm who from Redwood will be the executive sponsor/presenter (CTO-level or a product VP) so we can coordinate internal briefings? I can also loop in our procurement contact if we need to pin a representative for SOW/terms questions.

Attached a short priority doc outlining our success criteria.

Thanks,
Cara Morris
Director, Platform Partnerships
Novatech

Attachments: Novatech_Exec_Priority.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Cara Morris <cara.morris@novatech.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive briefing lane request — Novatech demo

Hi Cara — great to hear and thanks for sending the priorities. We're excited to run this with your leadership.

We can do a 45-minute executive demo and would like to propose two concrete options so you can pick what's best for CTO + VP: 
- Tue, Nov 23, 2027 10:00–10:45 PT (best for our CTO coverage)
- Wed, Nov 24, 2027 14:00–14:45 PT (alternate that works for our PM lead)

For the sponsor: Sean Gallagher (Head of Solutions) will be the named exec sponsor/presenter; Olga Petrov (Customer Success Lead) will manage prebriefs and follow-up. I've CC'd them here to confirm availability.

If either slot works, I can send a formal calendar invite and a short pre-read. Also note: our execs prefer a 15–20 minute prebrief with the VP the morning of the demo (or 30 minutes prior) to align on success criteria — would that be possible on your side?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: (internal) Novatech exec demo — coverage and prebrief

Folks — Cara confirmed Novatech wants CTO + VP on the exec demo. They asked for morning slots the week of 11/22; I proposed 11/23 10:00 PT as primary and 11/24 14:00 PT as backup.

Sean: can you own the executive presentation portion if the CTO has to drop? The ask is to surface routing policies, SLOs, and fallback behavior — your slides on routing failover would be perfect.
Olga: can you own the VP prebrief at ~09:30 PT on 11/23 and run the logistics (dial-in, recording, attendee list)? Also loop in Solutions Engineer for a quick dry run if possible.

If either of you has a hard block on those times, let me know and I'll push to the alternative slot. We should also prep a 1-page pre-read for the VP. I'll draft and share a quick version by Monday.

Thanks — S

From: Cara Morris <cara.morris@novatech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive briefing lane request — Novatech demo

Stephanie — 11/23 10:00 PT works for both our CTO (Anil Rao) and VP (Maya Patel).

Request from our side: our VP would like a 15-minute prebrief at 09:30 PT on the same day to align on what success looks like and a quick run of the agenda. Our procurement contact (novatech-sales+procurement@novatech.com) will also be on the call to listen in.

Can you send the calendar invite and pre-read? We'll also send a short attendee-role CSV to help structure the Q&A.

Thanks,
Cara

Attachments: novatech-exec-briefing-roles.csv

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Cara Morris <cara.morris@novatech.com>, novatech-sales+procurement@novatech.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive briefing lane request — Novatech demo

Thanks Cara — confirmed. Agenda and logistics below; official calendar invite and recording link are attached.

Agenda (11/23, 10:00–10:45 PT)
- 09:30–09:45 PT: VP prebrief (private call with Maya Patel) — join link below
- 10:00–10:20 PT: Short product demo (high level, routing & SLOs)
- 10:20–10:35 PT: Deep dive — live failover demo and KV/cache behavior
- 10:35–10:45 PT: Q&A and next steps

Pre-reads attached: redwood-demo-onepager.pdf (1 page), and a short presenter note. We'll record the session for internal review. Dial-in: Google Meet link (in calendar invite).

Presenters: Sean Gallagher (exec sponsor/presenter), Stephanie Nguyen (sales owner), Olga Petrov (CS — prebrief & follow-up).

If anything changes on your attendee list, please flag and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-onepager.pdf
